lines.en: I walk out of the mire.
I slip forward one step at a time.
Mud clings to my body.
I walk slowly, head low.
I circle a stagnant pool.

lines.zh: 我拖着湿透的身子，走过浅滩。
lines.en: I haul my soaked body across the shallows.
I head your way.
I break a reed underfoot.

lines.zh: 泥没到我的膝盖，我照样拔腿。
lines.en: Mud reaches my knees, yet I keep pulling my legs free.
I walk without stopping.
I shuffle two steps closer.
I stand in the muddy water.
I tilt my head and sniff the air.

lines.zh: 苦沼的泥水，从我的鳃缝漏出来。
lines.en: Mire water leaks through my gill slits.
Something moves under the mud.
I stare at the reeds.
I let my hand hang in the water.

lines.zh: 我泡在水里的腿，一动不动。
lines.en: The legs I keep in the water do not stir.
This place is damp and close.
Mire mud clings to my legs.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，眼睛在泥下发光。
lines.en: I lift my head, my eyes glowing under the mud.
You have walked into my mire.
The water here is not clean.
Take a step and you will see.

lines.zh: 我从泥里直起腰，水顺着鳃流下。
lines.en: I straighten up out of the mud, water running off my gills.
My fingers spread in the water.
You cannot see what is under there.
You cannot back out now.

lines.zh: 你的靴子陷进泥里，我不急。
lines.en: Your boots sink into the mire and I feel no hurry.
My breath shows on the water.
I step back, splattering mud.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里咕噜一声，退进芦苇。
lines.en: A gurgle leaves my throat as I back into the reeds.
Half in the water, I watch you.
I grab at the reeds.
I lick the wound and the salt stings.

lines.zh: 我扶着泥岸，把身子撑起来。
lines.en: I brace a hand on the muddy bank and push myself up.
I am not leaving.

lines.zh: 泥里打过滚，这点伤不算什么。
lines.en: I've rolled in the mud; a scratch like this is nothing.
Drop it in.
I do not eat dry things.
Leave it by the water.
I reach for it.
Lower your hand a little.
That is not what I want.
I sink into the water with only my eyes showing.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，让我挪不开脚。
lines.en: Your scent keeps my feet from moving on.
I ram your leg.

lines.zh: 我们身上的泥混在一起。
lines.en: Our mud mixes.

lines.zh: 你被顶得后退，泥沼里太滑。
lines.en: You get shoved back; the mire is slick.
My body is wet and slippery.
My shoulders are broad.
The impact is dull.

lines.zh: 我从泥沼里出来，泥挂了一身。
lines.en: I come out of the mire coated in mud.
Mud splashes over both of us.
Do not run in the mud.
There are others in the mire.
We hide under the same water.
We do not need to make a sound.
The mud surface shifts.
Two pairs of eyes break the surface.
We sink again.
The reeds sway.
There is room enough here.
It is quiet under the water.
I dig it out of the mud.
It has been soaked soft.
I shake it.
I stuff it into the hide at my waist.
What is under the mud is mine.
I look and throw it back.
I will use it for bait.
I bend and pick it up again.

lines.zh: 我沉到只露出两只眼睛。
lines.en: I sink until only my two eyes show.
Bubbles rise on the mud.
I swim at you.
The water swallows sound.
I will pull you under.
There is no bottom here.
Your feet are sinking.
I hear the mire being stirred.
I lift my hand out of the water.
The swamp saw me first.
I do not like strangers.
My mouth opens under the muddy water.
In the miserable mire I follow along the ground.
The mud sucks at your boots.
Only one ring is left on the water.
I have your ankle.
The more you struggle, the deeper you sink.
I crawl forward again.
Only rings remain on the surface.
I listen to your heartbeat.
I am right below.
Do not look down.
I wait behind the reeds.

lines.zh: 你每拔一次脚，我就近一点。
lines.en: Every time you pull a foot free, I come a little closer.

lines.zh: 水面上只有一圈圈的纹。
lines.en: Only rings move on the water.

lines.zh: 泥面冒出一串泡，是我在下面。
lines.en: A string of bubbles breaks the mud; that is me below.
I touch the stones under the mud.
I know this place far better than you.
I lay my body across the path.
You have turned three times.
My nails rake your skin.

lines.zh: 我一口咬在你湿透的裤腿上。
lines.en: I bite into your soaked trouser leg.
Water pours into your boots.
You struggle backward.
I shake my head, spraying mud.
That drag did not go deep.
I submerge again.
You cannot keep your feet.
I burst out of the water.

lines.zh: 我的手掌拍在泥上，水花四溅。
lines.en: My palm hits the mud and water sprays.
I have your boot.
You kick my chest.
I loosen my grip.
I catch you again.
That one knocks you down.
Mud pours into your collar.

lines.zh: 你滑倒了，我顺势压上去。
lines.en: You slip, and I press my weight down on you.
I surface from under the mire.
This is the Miserable Mire.
I stand among the reeds.
The surface shows no ripple.
I open my eyes.
I move slowly toward the bank.
A seam opens in the mud.
The mire parts around me.
I stand in this dead water.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我赶紧沉底。
lines.en: Fire burns on the water and I dive.

lines.zh: 水比我想的深，我挣不上去。
lines.en: The water is deeper than I thought; I cannot rise.

lines.zh: 爆炸把泥水掀起来，我被甩到岸上。
lines.en: The blast throws up mud and me onto the bank.

lines.zh: 悲惨沼泽的泥里，我等着。
lines.en: In the mire of the Miserable Mire, I wait.
Spell-light cracks across the water.
There is little to eat around here.

lines.zh: 雷打在水上，我全身一阵麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and I go numb.
